The Mela Before Sunset

Scene Description (Location and Angles):
HOOK – SCREEN 1 (the situation)
Location: Chaupal under the big banyan tree, next to the Panchayat Bhawan. Morning, bright sun.
Angle: Wide shot. Baba stands on the left. Guddu Bhaiya stands on the right with a fat notebook and a pen.
Action: The narrator box shows first. Then Baba asks his question. Guddu Bhaiya scratches his head and writes very fast.
Visual Assests:
BG: Panchayat Bhawan (chaupal)
Characters: Baba, Guddu Bhaiya
Props: fat notebook, pen, Mela bunting on the tree
Anim: the character who speaks bounces gently
BGM: BGM Village 1
Dialogues:
NARRATOR: Today is Mela day in Apnapur! Tonight there will be lights, sweets and a big giant wheel. The Panchayat has ₹6,00,000 to buy things for the Mela. But the shops close when the sun goes down.

BABA: Guddu, is our money enough?

GUDDU BHAIYA: Wait… 42,538 plus 23,184… carry one… Let me write it all down!

Scene Description (Location and Angles):
HOOK – SCREEN 2 (the problem and the mission)
Location: Same chaupal. The sun is a little lower (warm orange light).
Angle: Wide shot. Aaru runs in from the left with Gudiya. Guddu Bhaiya is in the middle, still writing. Pari stands on the right.
Action: Aaru shouts a wild number. Pari shakes her head, smiles, and points toward the bazaar.
Visual Assests:
BG: Panchayat Bhawan (chaupal) + warm tint
Characters: Aaru, Guddu Bhaiya, Pari, Gudiya
Anim: small sun icon appears top-right (Sunset tracker starts)
BGM: BGM Village 1
Dialogues:
NARRATOR: Guddu Bhaiya adds every number fully. It takes a long time. The sun is going down.

AARU: Easy! The total is ten crore!

PARI: Aaru, that is a wild guess. Let's make a smart guess.

PARI: First, we change each price to a round number. Round numbers are easy to add. A smart guess like this is called an estimate.

PARI: Come! Let's go to the bazaar.
On screen text (OST):
Smart guess = Estimate
[Go to the bazaar]

Scene Description (Location and Angles):
LEVEL 1 SETTING – Aakoli Bazaar (used for the level 1 screens)
Location: Busy bazaar street with 7 stalls in a row.
Angle: Side view of the street. The background slides a little to the right for each new shop, so the child feels they are walking down the bazaar.
Action: At each shop a price tag swings on a string. Pari stands bottom-left. Manju Mausi appears only on the teaching screen (bottom-right, at her tea and sweet shop).
Visual Assests:
BG: Aakoli Bazaar (wide, pans left→right)
Characters: Pari; Manju Mausi (teaching screen)
Props: hanging price tag (cream card on string), number line (brown bar, mid-point mark), 2 wooden answer buttons, red arrow marker, red stamp
HUD: level chip "Aakoli Bazaar · Round the price tags", 7 marigolds, sunset tracker, "Shop X of 7" chip
SFX: bell (correct), goat bleat (wrong)
Dialogues: See the Game sheet, screens 4–13, for every line.
On screen text (OST):
Aakoli Bazaar · Round the price tags
Shop 1 of 7 … Shop 7 of 7
Rule strip: Hundreds digit 5 or more → go up. Less than 5 → stay down.

Scene Description (Location and Angles):
BRIDGE 1 (end of level 1)
Location: Far end of Aakoli Bazaar street.
Angle: Mid shot. Pari on the left, Aaru on the right, both happy.
Action: All 7 marigolds glow. Aaru does a little jump. Pari points toward the Panchayat office.
Visual Assests:
BG: Aakoli Bazaar (panned to the far end)
Characters: Pari, Aaru
HUD: 7 marigolds lit
SFX: bell + short cheer
Dialogues:
AARU: All the prices are round numbers now! Correct-correct!

PARI: Well done! The shopkeepers sent their bills to the Panchayat office. Let's check them.

SFX: paper swish, bell, goat bleat
Dialogues: See the Game sheet, screens 14–23, for every line.

Panchayat office · Add the bills
Bill 1 … Bill 7

Scene Description (Location and Angles):
BRIDGE 2 (end of level 2)
Location: Panchayat office, inside.
Angle: Mid shot. Pari on the left, Guddu Bhaiya on the right with his notebook open.
Action: The 'done' pile has all 7 bills. Guddu Bhaiya looks at the pile, then at his notebook, very surprised.

BG: Govt. Office Interior 2

GUDDU BHAIYA: All seven bills? So fast? I am still on page two!

PARI: The shopkeepers are waiting at the Mela Ground. Baba has the money. Let's go and pay them.

[Go to the Mela Ground]

Angle: Wide shot. Aaru, Pari and Gudiya on the left. Baba and Guddu Bhaiya on the right.
Action: Guddu Bhaiya holds up his notebook. Pari smiles. Aaru jumps. Gudiya hops.
Visual Assests:
BG: Village Mela Ground + dusk tint
Characters: Aaru, Pari, Gudiya, Baba, Guddu Bhaiya
Props: string of 7 lit bulbs, Guddu's notebook
SFX: festive crowd, bell
BGM: BGM Village 1 (louder, festive)
Dialogues:
NARRATOR: The sun goes down. The Mela lights come on! The giant wheel starts to turn. We bought everything, and there is still money left.

GUDDU BHAIYA: I finished! Exactly ₹83,380 is left.

PARI: We said about ₹84,000. That is nearly the same!

AARU: Correct-correct! Now jalebi for everyone!

NARRATOR: The Sarpanch gives you a gold badge.
